%s coordinator: INCIDENT recorded for the run - the session working directory drifted into runs/run-004-harry-potter-party/artifacts during a verification step, and because .claude/settings.json registered the hooks as bare relative commands ('python3 .claude/hooks/<hook>.py') the hooks resolved to a nonexistent path and failed closed. Because they are PreToolUse hooks, this denied every Write/Edit/Bash call in the main session AND in subagent sessions, including absolute-path writes, which halted the run at the step 3 -> step 4 boundary. No artifact was corrupted or lost: all six artifacts and this state file were verified hash-clean afterwards. The fix applied to .claude/settings.json replaces the relative hook commands with 'python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/<hook>.py"', which makes hook resolution independent of the session cwd. All 23 hook unit tests still pass after the change. This is a genuine repo hardening, not just a local workaround: a committed hook that only resolves from one cwd would fail for anyone running the workflow from a subdirectory.
